_publications._publicationTitle: Traditional and systems biology based drug discovery for the rare tumor syndrome neurofibromatosis type 2
_publications._context: Syn4 is one of three merlin-deficient isogenic arachnoidal cell lines in the AC-CRISPR panel, generated by CRISPR/Cas9 NF2 inactivation of the same parental line used for the wildtype controls Syn1/Syn2.

basicInfo.description: Merlin-deficient arachnoidal cell line from the Synodos NF2 AC-CRISPR panel, generated by CRISPR/Cas9 NF2 inactivation; isogenic with wildtype controls Syn1/Syn2.
